verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's product page directly claims org-wide enforcement of code quality and compliance policies via 'standardized, customizable merge checks', backed by claims of enforcing coding standards and CI/CD policies across all repositories and granular branch-level permissions. The evidence is only marketing-level, though. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on which merge check types exist and how they are configured or customized, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the checks are enforced.
